Score retained after the source correction; no new perceptual evidence.

findings.evidence: src/journey-rhythm.js:52, src/journey-rhythm.js:54, src/journey-rhythm.js:55, src/journey-rhythm.js:56, src/journey-rhythm.js:58; tests/journey-rhythm.mjs:32
findings.detail: The previously reported single-slot guide overwrite and premature visual-tail loss are resolved in the inspected source. Each sung onset enters a bounded 32-event array; singingNow selects the latest event at or before audibleTime. Clearing the scheduling state at the two-bar end no longer discards those events, so the final cue retains its normal audible lifetime. A changed guide key clears old events. The added test text asserts current cue selection with 400 ms output latency, future lookahead, the final tail and stale-round clearing. Tests were read, not run by this reviewer.
findings.consequence: The identified static cause of missing or truncated demonstration highlights is removed. Physical audiovisual alignment remains unverified.
findings.remedy: No further source remedy for this finding. Validate the implementation on actual output devices as covered by the remaining limitation.

findings.detail: The inspected timing checks use substituted clocks, timers and AudioContext nodes. They specify expected scheduling behavior, but do not measure browser input delivery, timer jitter, display refresh, physical speaker/Bluetooth delay or haptic onset. These tests were read, not executed during this review.
findings.consequence: Actual simultaneous touch, light and sound remains unverified even where the arithmetic is internally consistent.
findings.remedy: Observe direct cube presses on a representative phone with its speaker and a Bluetooth output, recording touch-to-feedback and audio-to-light alignment; retain perceptual audio and sensation scores as unobserved until that evidence exists.

limits: No screenshots were inspected; visual, perceptual audio and sensation scores remain null. Presence of scripted fixtures does not provide listening or human-play evidence.

No tests or browser/audio runs were performed by this reviewer. The coordinator reported full254 Node and focused browser passes; those reports are not treated as independent observations or listening evidence here.

Empty-space taps intentionally defer activation until release to distinguish dragging and holding (src/canvas.js:40, src/canvas.js:66); the direct cube press path is immediate. This interaction choice is not classified as a defect without play evidence.
Black space, Geist Mono, the small cube, preserved generation/music, eleven sequentially unlocked ring places and slow transitions are accepted constraints, not defects.
